extensions.name: Sigakhwa Click-to-Ask
extensions.description: Turns boxes of a Mermaid diagram into follow-up questions with confirmation. When an assistant reply carries a ```sigakhwa-actions block, each bound box previews its prepared prompt before sending once, into the same conversation and profile, through WebUI's own send path. Selecting text in a reply offers four quick asks: explain simply, check the evidence, visualize, compare alternatives.
